steps.content:
Based on the information on those two pages, there is **no meaningful difference** between the two sellers - you can buy from either one.

I checked both listings and they are identical on every factor shown:

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Availability / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | Same - over-ear closed back, ANC with transparency, 40h battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, headphones/case/USB-C cable/3.5mm cable | Same |

Same product, same price, same shipping time and cost, same return policy, same warranty, same rating, and same stock status.

**Why either is fine:** There is nothing in the listings themselves that makes one a better deal than the other.

If you have to pick one, you can pick either arbitrarily - for example by seller name preference or any prior experience you have with them outside of this listing - but based *only* on what's shown on those two pages, neither has an advantage.
